source_baseline.note: Page event record is not a unique human. Zero persisted CTA records is not proof of zero real user activity. Payment evidence from the provider remains unverified; actual global revenue outside this register is unknown.

root_cause: Existing original owner-only Portal V2 shows separate social post 48h, closed-week website, email reply and CRO revenue sources but lacks one 8-stage original funnel proof map with exact source owner, missing data guard and prioritized implementation for same canonical agents. Activity can be mistaken for paid orders or baseline-zero conversion.
correction: Pure zero-side-effect, fail-closed ONE BRAIN revenue funnel projector reuses existing original Powerhouse growthDirection, socialFunnel, original conversionEvidence, compoundImprovement, readStates; renders one canonical admin-only stage/priority table in original Andere data portal. It never issues sends, changes schedulers or converts observed metrics into paid buyer claims.
prevention: Fail closed if CRO source stale or missing; do not infer zero from missing.
Do not sum views/likes/replies/website events/leads and paid orders as one population or claim daily guaranteed growth.
Prioritize exact consented CTA producer→202→drain→persisted readback before running an unmeasured CTA variant.
Keep original LinkedIn/Instagram and email sender duplicate guard, age-matched provider-ID, privacy/consent and original customer identity proof.
Never count payment provider reference, forecast or internal action as independently paid revenue; require provider webhook/paid ID and tenant attribution.
Any strategy must be evaluated on real cohorts and actual source-backed customer outcome, naturally applied in next original agent run.
No extra writer, scheduler, AI/marketing side effect, payment or customer credential.
